mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (historical low threshold), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals an impending economic slowdown, prompting the Federal Reserve to implement monetary easing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show positive growth (e.g., >0.5% MoM), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0.5% annualized growth signals a supply-side contraction, which increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800,000 units annually signals weak consumer confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 800.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a labor market mismatch (e.g., job openings outpacing workers), which signals economic overheating and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive and UNRATE is rising, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.
